The South unit patient failed the sit-to-stand assessment and requires a full-body bariatric lift for every bed-to-chair transfer. The North unit patient, on the other hand, can currently complete a two-person stand-pivot transfer with a gait belt. Based on these clinical findings, my recommendation is that the bariatric lift be assigned to the South unit patient, who has no safe alternative transfer method available.
